name: Chip Decapsulation
description: Removal of integrated circuit packaging to expose the silicon die for further analysis. Covers chemical decapsulation (acid etching with fuming nitric acid, sulfuric acid), mechanical decapsulation (CNC milling, laser ablation), plasma decapsulation, and package-specific techniques for BGA, QFN, QFP, WLCSP, and multi-die/stacked-die packages. Proper decapsulation is the critical first step for all invasive and many semi-invasive analysis techniques.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands IC packaging types and decapsulation methods
evidence: Can identify common IC package types (QFP, BGA, QFN, WLCSP, SiP)
Understands chemical, mechanical, and plasma decapsulation methods at a conceptual level
Aware of chemical safety requirements for acid handling in the decapping lab

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs decapsulation on standard package types under supervision
evidence: Safely handles fuming nitric acid and sulfuric acid following lab chemical safety protocols
Decapsulates standard plastic packages (QFP, QFN) using chemical etching under guidance
Operates the automated decapsulation station (e.g., Nisene JetEtch) for routine packages
Verifies die integrity after decapsulation using optical microscopy

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently decapsulates diverse package types while preserving die and bond wires
evidence: Decapsulates BGA, WLCSP, and multi-chip packages without damaging bond wires or die surface
Selects appropriate decapsulation method and parameters for unfamiliar package types
Performs partial decapsulation to expose specific die regions while maintaining device functionality
Maintains consistent quality across decapsulation batches with documented success rates

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex and novel packaging; develops decapsulation procedures; mentors team
evidence: Decapsulates advanced packages (3D-stacked, fan-out wafer-level, SiP with embedded dies)
Develops and documents decapsulation recipes for new package types
Performs live decapsulation maintaining device electrical functionality for semi-invasive analysis
Mentors team on chemical safety, technique selection, and quality control

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on IC decapsulation; defines lab methodology; specifies equipment
evidence: Defines the lab's decapsulation methodology and chemical safety procedures
Evaluates and specifies decapsulation equipment for lab procurement
Develops novel decapsulation techniques for emerging package technologies
Trains teams and conducts proficiency assessments for decapsulation operators

assessment_methods.description: Decapsulate a set of devices in different package types, demonstrating correct method selection, safety compliance, and die preservation quality
Observe chemical handling, PPE usage, process control, and quality verification during a live decapsulation session

equipment: Automated decapsulation station (e.g., Nisene JetEtch Pro)
Chemical fume hood with acid-rated exhaust
CNC mill or laser ablation system for mechanical decapsulation
